notes.title: Steam Workshop Integration
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332936/6a8c1f44074239afe22d2f75137f0cdb0f7f30a9.jpg

Recently we implemented a tool for uploading items to the Steam Workshop.
We are now fully prepared to periodically replace existing drop items with your creations. In the future, we plan to exclude old items from the drop system.

At this moment we have added 2 new items from the workshop:

  [color=#247fee]Envelope[/color]
  [color=#ae33fc]Banana[/color]
